product_title: Royal Peacock Shubh Labh Door Hangings
product_description: Bring traditional charm to your home with this handcrafted pair of door hangings, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, elegant peacock designs, auspicious Shubh Labh detailing, and intricate golden embellishments. Finished with pearl tassels, they are perfect for festive entrances, pooja rooms, Diwali, and housewarming celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearl tassels and decorative elements carefully.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
